description: Capability for the main window. NOTE on the externalBin sidecars (`myne`, `myne-tor`): neither is launched from the webview, so neither gets a permission here. `myne` is run by the user from a terminal; `myne-tor` (arti, MYND-650) is spawned host-side by Rust when the device-local Tor routing option is on. A Tauri capability grants the WEBVIEW an IPC surface — so adding `shell:allow-execute` (or any process-spawn permission) to launch a sidecar would hand page-context code the ability to start the network-bearing Tor proxy, which is strictly worse than the host owning it. If you came here to add one: don't; the launch belongs in the host lifecycle module.
